role: Post-open retrospective two-implementation envelope audit of the direct composition that uses the sealed equal-call linear-heat frame-zero field and the sealed causal warm K14 field on frames 1 through 32.
scientific_question: Can the already available absolute-safe frame-zero linear control be composed with the later-frame causal warm K14 candidate to satisfy the frozen Case 19 absolute and K16-matched full-trajectory contract at fewer nominal exact calls?

retrospective_integrity.purpose: Turn an already inspected route-audit calculation into a fail-closed, independently recomputed receipt and prevent an absolute-only composition from being mislabeled matched-accuracy or effective call reduction.

preformalization_revision.failure: Before any formal output was created, a fixed 1e-12 cross-parent K16 identity check rejected the already sealed v244 formal replica even though the independently recomputed v250 K16 frame-zero values agree with the v244 implementation envelope.
preformalization_revision.repair: Replace the arbitrary fixed cross-parent tolerance with the parameter-free requirement that each v244-v250 K16 frame-zero discrepancy be no larger than the maximum already sealed v244 formal-independent metric discrepancy across all arms, rigs, frames and metrics.

unique_retrospective_primary.name: linear_heat_frame_zero_plus_causal_warm_k14_later_frames
unique_retrospective_primary.formal_replica_composition: Use v250 formal linear-heat arm at frame 0 and v244.2 formal causal-warm primary arm at frames 1 through 32.
unique_retrospective_primary.independent_replica_composition: Use v250 independent linear-heat arm at frame 0 and v244.2 independent causal-warm primary arm at frames 1 through 32.
unique_retrospective_primary.reference_replica: Use the matching v244.2 formal or independent K16 arm for all 33 frames.
unique_retrospective_primary.componentwise_lower: Elementwise minimum of the composed formal and independent replicas.
unique_retrospective_primary.componentwise_upper: Elementwise maximum of the composed formal and independent replicas.
unique_retrospective_primary.robust_absolute_cell: All candidate upper metric bounds are at or below the strict cell limits.
unique_retrospective_primary.robust_matched_cell: All candidate upper metric bounds are at or below 1.05 times the corresponding reference lower metric bounds.
unique_retrospective_primary.robust_complete_rig_absolute: All 33 robust absolute cells pass and candidate-upper p90-higher and worst are within the frozen absolute tail limits.
unique_retrospective_primary.robust_complete_rig_matched: All 33 robust matched cells pass and candidate-upper/reference-lower p90-higher and worst ratios are at or below 1.02 and 1.05.
unique_retrospective_primary.v250_v244_frame_zero_k16_crosscheck_rule: Each formal and independent v244-v250 K16 frame-zero maximum absolute difference must be no larger than the maximum sealed v244 formal-independent metric difference across all arms, rigs, frames and metrics.

formal_method.implementation: Vectorized NumPy composition, componentwise envelopes, method=higher quantiles and exact call-ledger summation.
formal_method.output: One JSON report and READY seal in a previously absent output directory.

independent_method.implementation: Explicit scalar arm/rig/frame/metric loops and sorted-index higher quantiles; do not import the formal v251 implementation.
independent_method.required_agreement: All counts, failure rosters, tails, call ledgers, booleans and final decision agree; numeric values agree within 1e-12.

decision_order: Any protocol, source, parent identity, shape, dtype, finite, output-exclusivity, cross-parent K16, formal-independent or seal mismatch gives INCONCLUSIVE_INVALID_CASE19_COLD_START_LINEAR_HYBRID_ATTRIBUTION_V251.

If any robust hybrid absolute or K16-matched cell or complete-rig gate fails, conclude FAIL_CASE19_COLD_START_LINEAR_HYBRID_MATCHED_ACCURACY_V251 and close this direct composition. Nominal call arithmetic is not an effective call reduction.
If the hybrid passes all robust absolute and matched gates but the K16 reference fails its robust absolute contract, conclude INCONCLUSIVE_CASE19_COLD_START_LINEAR_HYBRID_REFERENCE_INADEQUATE_V251.

Only if the hybrid and reference both pass every robust gate may conclude PASS_CASE19_COLD_START_LINEAR_HYBRID_MATCHED_ACCURACY_V251. Even then, this post-open audit would require a new unopened external condition before an algorithm or generalization claim.
failure_action: Close the direct frame-zero linear-heat plus later-frame causal-warm K14 composition. Do not add K15 heat, expand linear smoothing, retune diffusion, alter thresholds, train CNN/FNO/UNO/DeepONet, rent a GPU, or claim effective exact-call reduction from this failed matched-accuracy audit.
